name: Takanawa-Gateway
tagline: Shinagawa in 2 minutes and Tokyo in 12 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, served by JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 18 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 2 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. The station stands 3.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 22.3 m. The land around the station rises and falls sharply.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 3.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.6 m to 24.9 m, a difference of 22.3 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 3 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: 成城石井 ニュウマン高輪店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 6 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 地域医療機能推進機構東京高輪病院, about 929 m away and 桜十字白金リハビリテーション病院, about 1362 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: JR Yamanote Line and JR Keihin-Tohoku Line. Both lines are run by JR East, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 52.

rentRange.note: One room ¥160,000 to ¥170,000, 1K ¥130,000 to ¥140,000, 1LDK ¥250,000 to ¥260,000 and 2LDK ¥360,000 to ¥370,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station rises and falls sharply, and living above or below the slope changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
